sections: A plant or part of a plant eaten as food, such as a carrot. Choose one vegetable for dinner.

articulation.label: potato
articulation.alt: potato: /p/ → /ə/ → /t/ → /eɪ/ → /t/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
